newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti to issue H1 details, meet analysts Sep 30.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti to issue H1 details, meet analysts Sep 30.

text.p: Troubled Italian high-tech group Olivetti said it will meet financial analysts at the same time as it makes public its full first half 1996 report on September 30.

Olivetti said in a statement that details of the meeting will be announced next week. The group originally set a meeting with analysts in Milan for next Monday, expected to be followed by a meeting in London in the following days.
It was not clear if Monday's meeting had been called off and there was no-one immediately available for comment at Olivetti's Ivrea headquarters.

The company's statement said: "Olivetti, in the spirit of providing the market with the most extensive information, has decided that it will meet the financial community concurrently with the public release of the six-monthly report, which is scheduled for September 30."
Olivetti surprised the stock market last week when it announced a first half loss of 440.2 billion lire and said its chairman of 18 years Carlo De Benedetti was stepping down.
Olivetti shares, which closed on Friday 0.3 percent down at 572.9 lire, have lost some 25 percent in the week.
